correctness.rationale: For each maximal point b_i, boundedness forces a maximal image. At each minimal a_i the two incident maximal labels are equal or cyclically adjacent, and this determines its image uniquely. This bijects all Heyting endomorphisms, by finite Esakia duality, with based closed lazy walks on an m-cycle. Their signed step sums are -m,0,m, giving m(central-trinomial+2) maps. Every zero-winding walk has a uniquely traversed proper path arc of k<=floor(m/2) edges; its image poset has k minima and k+1 maxima. Restricting upsets to the image poset is surjective, so the algebra image cardinality is the independent-set count F_(2k+3); nonzero winding yields 2m automorphisms of image size L_(2m). Closed walks on a path with both endpoints reached are counted by the trace B_(m,k)-2B_(m,k-1)+B_(m,k-2), proving all multiplicities. Independently enumerated small crowns m=3..7 and direct implication checks m=3,4 agree; finite tests are not used as a substitute for the all-m argument.

originality.rationale: The new precise assertion is the identification and complete image-cardinality distribution of endomorphisms of the finite crown Heyting algebras as bounded-morphism (Esakia) maps; this is mathematically different from the extensive literature counting all monotone crown maps or classifying their homotopy classes. The full text of the motivating 2023 regular-Heyting-algebra paper supplies the duality and regularity setting without a comparable crown endomorphism count. The 2023 finite-generation paper supplies the primary 03C05 context but does not entail the particular endomorphism census. Accessible published crown map studies were compared at theorem level and do not imply this bounded-map invariant. Classical sequence identities are explicitly not claimed as independently novel. Older full-text access risk is recorded and the claim is not presented as historically certified.
residual_risks: Full texts of Farley (1995) and Currie–Visentin (1992) were not inspected; one could contain a specialization to the p-morphism submonoid or to a related rank spectrum.
Unindexed older literature on finite Heyting endomorphisms, bounded morphisms or alternating-cycle maps might already express the same count under other terminology.
Mathematical verification of all infinite parameters is by proof reconstruction, not independent external audit.

value.rationale: The cardinalities of endomorphic images are intrinsic finite-Heyting-algebra invariants. The theorem computes the full image-cardinality spectrum and every frequency for all natural crown sizes m>=3, exhibiting a sparse sequence of Fibonacci ranks and a distinct Lucas automorphism rank. This links finite Esakia geometry, finite-algebra endomorphism structure, and constrained walks; it goes beyond a routine count of unrestricted monotone self-maps or a preexisting sequence identity, and can inform classification of homomorphic images and retracts.
